summary: Disclosure document and latest-body must return HTML or PDF text in the existing JSON shape from downloadHtml.do. Sniff decoded attachment bytes; use bounded cancellable Poppler pdftotext for PDF text layers. Missing extractor, unreadable PDF, or absent text must fail without raw PDF stdout.
reason: PSE EDGE attachments can be PDFs; metadata with empty text is not a successful document read. Keep this EDGE-specific decoder and dependency guidance through reprints.
